answer: Require every agent to stake a deposit that grows like a vine: each verified action adds a small bond, and the stake is slashed when peers detect fake identities. A public mirror ledger records every attestation, so a sybil cluster reusing the same behavior pattern becomes visible to all. Like a falcon circling overhead, random auditors sample agents and demand proof of unique hardware or payment history; creating thousands of fake agents then costs more than any reward they could steal.
